description: When a token has no pool against the quote wanted (ladder_pools shows none, or none that pays liquidity): plan a new Uniswap v4 pool for it on LoomDesk's open hook, with a flat 1% or 3% swap fee: nine tenths to liquidity providers, one tenth to the LoomDesk book. The quote can be ETH, USDG, a tokenized stock, LOOM, or any token with a real exit (2,000 USDG of liquidity on the chain and a route to USDG): LOOM/PONS, a memecoin against a memecoin. One-off cost about a dollar (1 USDG or 0.0004 ETH), paid by the owner. It opens at the price of the token's existing market. Expect its flow to be mostly arbitrage plus what routers send; a new pool starts with neither. The pool holds nothing until a ladder is built in it: the result's `then` carries the pool id and key for plan_ladder (with newPool), so the pool and the ladder can be planned together and signed in order.

feePct.description: the pool's swap fee in percent: 0.1 (rungs at least 0.01% wide), 0.5 (0.1%), or 1 to 5 (2%)

quote.description: "ETH", "USDG", or the address of the quote token: a tokenized stock, LOOM, or any token with an exit

name: plan_open_pool
title: Open a pool that pays its liquidity
